_about: Index of Van Ryder Games' free Gruesome Death PDFs: where each passage sits (page + crop band in PDF units, measured from the page bottom). No passage text is stored here; the app reads the publisher's own PDF at play time and shows the passage as an image. Entry = [killerId|null, kind, variant|null, title, page, top, bottom, [rollFrom, rollTo]|null].
